stem: Easter fell on 31 March in 2024 and on 20 April in 2025. Voltmarkt's LFL sales fell 4% in March 2025 and rose 9% in April 2025. What should the analyst check before calling April a strong month?

options.text: Whether April's average order value was higher than March's
Whether Easter's move shifted trade from March into April
Whether the stores opened in the past year grew faster in April
Whether the webshop grew faster than the stores did in April
